title: hieracium umbelliferum
intro: Hieracium umbelliferum, commonly known as hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family and is native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium umbelliferum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
